title.zh: 【澳大利亚 ASIC 拟对以数字资产结算的衍生品实施杠杆上限】
title.en: 【澳大利亚 ASIC 拟对以数字资产结算的衍生品实施杠杆上限】

current_state.zh: Australia's ASIC opened consultation to extend its CFD intervention order to 2037 and bring digital-asset-settled contracts under CFD rules, subjecting them to retail leverage caps, forced margin close-outs and negative balance protection, with comments due 9 November and ministerial approval still required.
current_state.en: Australia's ASIC opened consultation to extend its CFD intervention order to 2037 and bring digital-asset-settled contracts under CFD rules, subjecting them to retail leverage caps, forced margin close-outs and negative balance protection, with comments due 9 November and ministerial approval still required.
